F:
$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_ITAZURA1|0|$t1$Wmウード|7$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsウード|$Wa$Eキメ,|$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_20|Je bondis au milieu de la formation
ennemie, épée tirée, et je tournoie !$k$pJe ne suis plus un homme, mais un
derviche d'acier distribuant la mort !$k$pL'ennemi tombe telles les feuilles d'un
arbre en automne par grand vent !$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_19|Qu'est-ce que tu fais, Owain ?$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_16|Salutations, $Nu.$k$pJe fais les chroniques de la saga d'Owain
le Sombre, le Vengeur de la Justice.$k$pSon personnage principal : moi, dans une
histoire de sang et d'honneur.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_5|Owain le Sombre ?$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_10|Un titre qui m'a été décerné par les masses,
témoignage de peur et d'amour !$k$pLa rumeur est devenue légende et mon nom
est désormais connu de tous !$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_10|Est-ce que les gens t'appellent vraiment
comme ça ? Pour de vrai ?$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_3|Hum, pas encore. Mais ils le feront !$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_9|Eh bien, les rêves font la jeunesse,
je suppose.$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$Eキメ,|$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_15|Rêver est à la portée de tous. Mais si le
rêve devient légende, et que la légende...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_10|Le rêve devient légende...$k$pGrand bien te fasse.$k$pMais en tant que stratège, je me permets
de te déconseiller la tactique frontale.$k$pCelle qui consiste à bondir au milieu
de la formation ennemie...$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_8|$WvAh ha ha ! Ne vous en faites point, mortel !$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_5|Hein ?!$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_19|J'aperçois un groupe de dix hommes et
surgis dans la mêlée !$k$pJ'abats sans effort les deux premiers
d'une seule volée !$k$pJe croise le fer avec le troisième, il tombe !$k$pLe fer rencontre ses tripes et le mène à la
tombe !$k$pEt de quatre que j'éclate, et de cinq que
j'esquinte, le sixième fuit, pris de folie.$k$pDe taille et d'estoc, deux autres que je
change en loques !$k$p« Ne le prenez pas personnellement »
crie-je à la cantonade.$k$p« Venez en paix ou gisez en paix ! »$k$pLa poussière se disperse, il n'y a plus que
moi et mon adversaire.$k$pMon combat contre le général commence !$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_29|Le général ?$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_16|Mon épée étincelle d'un éclat glacé.
Wa-Shiiing ! Cling !$k$p« Ha ! Impressionnant, Général ! Personne
n'a jamais réussi à parer ce coup. »$k$pLe général chancèle et tombe à genoux.$k$p« Pitié, Owain le Sombre ! Pitié ! Je ne
pourrai jamais en supporter plus ! »$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_9|Moi non plus, d'ailleurs. J'en ai assez
entendu. On dirait une mauvaise pièce...$k
$Sbs1000|
G:
$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_ITAZURA1|0|$t1$Wmウード|7$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsウード|$Wa$Eキメ,|$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_20|...Ich springe mitten in die gegnerische
Formation, meine Klinge ein einziger Wirbel!$k$pIch bin kein Mensch mehr, sondern ein
Derwisch aus Tod und Stahl!$k$pSie fallen um wie Kegel auf der Bahn!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_19|Was machst du da, Owain?$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_16|Seid gegrüßt, $Nu.$k$pIch erzähle die Saga vom Finsteren Owain,
dem rächenden Rächer der Gerechtigkeit.$k$pEs ist eine Geschichte voll Blut und Ehre
und meinen ruhmreichen Heldentaten.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_5|Vom Finsteren Owain?$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_10|Ein Titel, den mir das Volk gab, zu gleichen
Teilen aus Angst und Liebe geboren!$k$pEs begann als Gerücht, wurde bald zur
Legende und der Name überall bekannt!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_10|Wirst du tatsächlich so genannt?
Also, von echten Leuten, meine ich?$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_3|Äh, noch nicht. Aber das werden sie noch
früh genug!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_9|Nun, es schadet nicht, große Träume zu
haben, nehme ich an.$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$Eキメ,|$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_15|Jeder Mensch kann träumen. Aber nur eine
Legende kann zum Mythos werden!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_10|Nur eine Legende kann zum...$k$pWeißt du was? Gut für dich.$k$pAber als Taktiker würde ich dir nicht raten,
mitten in eine Horde Feinde zu springen.$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_8|$p$WvHAHAHA! Sorgt Euch nicht,
STERBLICHER!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_5|Wie?!?$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_19|Ich sehe eine Gruppe von zehn Mann und
stürze mich auf sie! Ein Schlag fällt zwei!$k$pIch kreuze die Klinge mit dem Dritten...$k$pDa-dusch! Seine Gedärme verteilen sich
über den Boden!$k$pDer Fünfte fällt, der Sechste flieht im Wahn.
Zwei Schnitte bringen zwei Weitere zu Fall!$k$p"Ich bin euch nicht gram", rufe ich und töte.
"Ruhet in Frieden, denn ich finde NIE Ruhe!"$k$pAls der Staub sich legt, stehen noch zwei.$k$pMein entscheidender Kampf mit dem bösen
General beginnt!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_29|Es gibt einen bösen General?$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_16|Mein Schwert ist ein flimmernder Blitz kalten
blauen Stahls. Ka-tsching! Pling! Ding!$k$p"Hahaha! Beeindruckend, General.
Den hat noch nie jemand abgewehrt."$k$pDer General schwankt auf unsteten Füßen,
dann sackt er, beschämt, auf die Knie.$k$p"Gnade, Finsterer Owain! Habt Gnade!
Noch so einen Schlag ertrage ich nicht!"$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_9|Es ist, als würde man eine bizarre Ein-Mann-
Vorstellung betrachten...$k
$Sbs1000|
I:
$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_ITAZURA1|0|$t1$Wmウード|7$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsウード|$Wa$Eキメ,|$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_20|... E balzo in mezzo ai ranghi nemici,
lama sguainata, roteando su me stesso!$k$pNon sono più umano, ma un potente vortice
di acciaio e morte!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_19|Cosa stai facendo, Owain?$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_16|Ciao, $Nu.$k$pSto narrando la saga di Owain l'Oscuro,
il Vendicativo Vendicatore della Giustizia.$k$pÈ una storia di sangue e onore, in cui
solitamente compio gesta grandiose.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_5|Owain l'Oscuro?$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_10|Un titolo voluto a gran voce dal popolo,
scaturito da un misto di paura e rispetto!$k$pCiò che un tempo era una voce oggi è una
leggenda e il mio nome è noto nel mondo!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_10|La gente ti chiama veramente così?
Intendo dire, gente vera? Che esiste?$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_3|Ehm, non ancora. Ma lo faranno!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_9|Beh, è bene avere dei sogni
di grandezza, suppongo.$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$Eキメ,|$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_15|Chiunque può sognare. Ma solo una
leggenda può entrare nel mito!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_10|Solo una leggenda può...$k$pSai che ti dico? Buon per te.
L'importante è crederci.$k$pMa in qualità di stratega, non ti consiglio
di balzare in mezzo a un'orda di nemici.$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_8|$WvAH AH AH! NON TEMERE, MORTALE!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_5|Eh?!$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_19|Individuo un gruppo di dieci uomini e mi
lancio nella mischia! Un colpo, due in meno!$k$pIncrocio la spada col terzo... Swooosh!
Le sue budella si riversano sul terreno!$k$pAlla morte del quinto, il sesto si dà alla
fuga! Un fendente e cadono altri tre.$k$p"Non voletemene", grido pugnando.
"Riposate in pace! O riposate in pezzi!"$k$pAlla fine, rimaniamo solo in due. Inizia
la battaglia finale col generale malvagio!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_29|C'è un generale malvagio?$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_16|La mia spada saetta in avanti, in un
lampeggiare fulmineo di freddo acciaio blu!$k$p"Ah ah ah! Mi sorprendete, generale.
Nessuno ha mai parato questo colpo."$k$pIl generale si avvicina trascinando i piedi,
poi cade in ginocchio umiliato.$k$p"Pietà, Owain l'Oscuro! Abbi pietà, poiché
non posso difendermi da un altro attacco!"$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_9|(È come guardare una strana sorta
di spettacolo individuale...)$k
$Sbs1000|
S:
$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_ITAZURA1|0|$t1$Wmウード|7$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsウード|$Wa$Eキメ,|$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_20|¡Salto en medio de la formación enemiga,
desenvaino mi hoja y empiezo a girar!$k$p¡Ya no soy un hombre! ¡Soy un torbellino de
muerte y acero! ¡Todos caen como moscas!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_19|¿Puedo saber qué estás haciendo, Owain?$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_16|Saludos, $Nu.$k$pEsta es la historia de Owain el Destructor,
vengador vengativo de la justicia.$k$pEs un apasionante relato de sangre y honor.
Básicamente, cuenta lo genial que soy.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_5|¿Owain el Destructor?$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_10|Es mi nombre de guerra, ¡un nombre
que inspira tanto amor como terror!$k$p¡Lo que era un rumor se convierte en
leyenda y se extiende por todo el mundo!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_10|¿Y la gente te llama así? Me refiero a la
gente real, la de carne y hueso.$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_3|Hum, todavía no.
Pero ¡lo harán!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_9|Bueno, supongo que es bueno tener
un sueño que perseguir.$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$Eキメ,|$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_15|Todos los hombres tienen sueños. Mas ¡solo
una leyenda puede convertirse en mito!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_10|Solo una leyenda puede convertirse...$k$p¿Sabes qué? Me parece genial.$k$pPero, como estratega, te aconsejo que no
saltes en medio de un grupo de enemigos.$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_8|$Wv¡JA, JA, JA! ¡NO TEMAS, MORTAL!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_5|¡¿Qué?!$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_19|¡Diez enemigos veo y cargo como un loco!
¡De un solo tajo, dos caen como poco!$k$pLuego cruzo mi espada con el tercero,
¡clang! Pronto su tripas decoran el suelo.$k$pMuere el quinto y el sexto sale por patas.
¡Un poco de sajarraja, y dos más a la caja!$k$p"No es personal", grito entre sablazos.
"¡Os traigo la paz! ¡Os hago PEDAZOS!"$k$pEl polvo al fin se posa, se acerca el final...
¡Un duelo a muerte con el malvado general!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_29|¿Hay un malvado general?$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_16|Mi espada brilla con un destello cegador.
¡Cling, clang! ¡Prueba mi acero vengador!$k$p"¡Ja, ja, ja! ¡General, estoy impresionado!
¡Eso hasta ahora nadie lo había parado!"$k$pEl general tiembla, sus pies le fallan.
Cae de rodillas, las fuerzas le faltan.$k$p"¡Owain el Destructor! ¡Os suplico piedad!
¡Otro golpe como ese no podré soportar!"$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_9|¡Creo que este tipo está loco de atar! $k
$Sbs1000|
U:
$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_ITAZURA1|0|$t1$Wmウード|7$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsウード|$Wa$Eキメ,|$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_20|...I leap into the centre of the enemy
formation, blade drawn, and spin!$k$pI'm no longer a man, but a whirling
dervish of death and steel!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_19|...What are you doing, Owain?$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_16|Oh, greetings, $Nu.$k$pI'm chronicling the saga of Owain Dark,
Avenger of Righteous Justice.$k$pIt's a tale of blood and honour and
me being generally amazing.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_5|Owain Dark?$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_10|A title bestowed upon me by the masses,
born of equal parts fear and love!$k$pWhat began as rumour soon became legend,
and my name spread throughout the world!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_10|Do people actually call you that?
I mean, real people? Who exist?$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_3|...Not yet.
But they will!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_9|Well, it's good to dream big,
I suppose.$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$Eキメ,|$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_15|Any man can dream. But only a
legend can become a myth!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_10|Only a legend can become...$k$pYou know what? Good for you.
Whatever floats your boat, I say.$k$pBut as a tactician, I'd advise against
jumping into a pack of enemies.$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_8|$WvHA HA HA! WORRY NOT, MORTAL!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_5|Gah?!$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_19|I spy a pack ten men strong and charge
into the fray! One swipe, and two fall!$k$pI lock swords with the third... CHING!
His guts spill forth upon the earth!$k$pAs the fifth falls, the sixth flees, driven mad.
A cut and a slash and three more are done!$k$p"I bear you no ill will," I cry as I slay.
"Rest in peace! Or rest in PIECES!"$k$pAs the dust settles, only two men yet stand.
My showdown with the evil general begins!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_29|There's an evil general?$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_16|My sword flashes out, a flickering blur
of cold blue steel. Ka-thwack! Schwing!$k$p"Ha ha ha! I'm impressed, General.
No one has blocked that before."$k$pThe general wobbles on unsteady feet,
then drops to his knees in shame.$k$p"Mercy, Owain Dark! Have mercy on me!
For I cannot abide another mighty blow!"$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_9|(It's like watching some kind of bizarre
one-man theatre performance...)$k
$Sbs1000|
TR:
$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_ITAZURA1|0|$t1$Wmウード|7$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsウード|$Wa$Eキメ|$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_20|...Düşman saflarının ortasına atlıyorum,
kılıcımı çekip dönüyorum!$k$pArtık bir insan değilim; ölüm ve çelikten
dönen bir kasırgayım!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_19|...Ne yapıyorsun, Owain?$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_16|Ah, selam,$Nu.$k$pAdil İntikamcı Owain Dark'ın destanını
yazıyorum.$k$pKan, onur ve benim olağanüstülüğüm üzerine
bir destan.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_5|Owain Dark mı?$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_10|Kitlelerin korku ve sevgiyle bana
bahşettiği bir unvan!$k$pFısıltıyla başladı, efsaneye dönüştü; adım
dünyaya yayıldı!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_10|İnsanlar sana gerçekten öyle mi diyor?
Gerçek insanlar yani?$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_3|...Henüz değil. Ama diyecekler!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_9|Büyük hayal kurmak iyidir, sanırım.$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$Eキメ|$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_15|Herkes hayal kurabilir. Ama yalnız bir
efsane söylenceye dönüşebilir!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_10|Yalnız bir efsane...$k$pBiliyor musun? Sana iyi eğlenceler. Nasıl
hoşuna gidiyorsa öyle yap.$k$pAma bir taktikçi olarak düşman grubunun
ortasına atlamamanı öneririm.$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_8|$WvHA HA HA! KORKMA, ÖLÜMLÜ!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_5|Gah?!$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_19|On kişilik bir birlik görüyorum ve savaşa
dalıyorum! Tek savuruşta ikisi düşüyor!$k$pÜçüncüyle kılıçlarımız çarpışıyor... ÇING!
Bağırsakları toprağa saçılıyor!$k$pBeşinci düşerken altıncı korkudan kaçıyor.
Bir kesiş, bir savuruş; üçü daha yerde!$k$p"Size kinim yok!" diye haykırıyorum.
"Huzur içinde yatın! Ya da PARÇALAR
hâlinde!"$k$pToz dindiğinde yalnız iki kişi ayakta.
Kötü generalle hesaplaşmam başlıyor!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_29|Kötü bir general de mi var?$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_16|Kılıcım soğuk mavi bir parıltıyla çakıyor.
Ka-çak! Şving!$k$p"Ha ha ha! Etkilendim, General. Bunu daha
önce kimse savuşturamadı."$k$pGeneral sendeleyip utanç içinde dizlerinin
üstüne çöküyor.$k$p"Merhamet, Owain Dark! Merhamet et! Bir
kudretli darbeye daha dayanamam!"$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_9|(Tuhaf bir tek kişilik tiyatro oyununu
izler gibiyim...)$k
$Sbs1000|

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_ITAZURA1|0|$t1$Wmウード|7$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsウード|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_8|Il est temps de dévoiler les tactiques
ingénieuses de mes prochaines batailles.$k$pAujourd'hui, je m'introduis au cœur de la
base ennemie : le Château de l'Apocalypse !$k$pCe qui veut dire que la fin se déroulera
sur les toits par un duel théâtral.$k$pTrès bien, allons-y...$k$pJe suis à l'avant-garde, je presse le pas et
prends de l'avance sur mes alliés !$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_19|Owain. Est-ce que tu es encore en train
de... visualiser tes futurs combats ?$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_10|Oui, mon pertinent ami.$k$pEt dans cet avenir, je vois... la conquête du
Château de l'Apocalypse !$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_9|Tout seul, sans doute...$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_9|Pardon, $Nu ?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_14|Rien ! Rien du tout.$k
$Wsウード|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_EUDES_EVT_16|Alors que le carnage commence !$k$p$Eキメ,|La mission est simple : capturer le seigneur
